metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for writing, reading, and reviewing code, infrastructure as code, and config.

plugins.name: iterative-review
plugins.description: Runs a review-and-fix loop on a pull request: Codex and a fresh Claude reviewer review in parallel, a Claude fix agent addresses the findings, Codex reviews the fixes, and Claude fixes again. Needs gh; the Codex CLI is optional.

plugins.name: next-item
plugins.description: Does the next item of a repository's implementation plan by following the "Doing the next item" section of its AGENTS.md.
